author: ruixen.ui
name: docks
description: This minimal and responsive theme toggle component lets users effortlessly switch between Light and Dark modes while offering quick access to settings. Designed with accessibility and clarity in mind, it features clean icons, smooth interactions, and full keyboard support. Perfect for dashboards, web apps, or portfolios, it enhances user experience and gives instant control over personalization. Built with React and TailwindCSS, it's easy to integrate, style, and extend as needed.
